prompt: I get a CSubItemUpdated event when a comment is added. How do I fetch the actual comment data?
expected_output: Shows getDescendant() with ancestry: event.ancestry, id: event.id, owner: event.owner. Notes that ancestry is root-first (ancestry.last is direct parent). Warns that getDescendant throws if CAncestor.owner is null.
assertions: Uses ancestry: event.ancestry and id: event.id from the event
Mentions that ancestry.last is the direct parent (root-first ordering)
Warns that getDescendant throws if CAncestor.owner is null
